claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Toyota Tacoma pickup and a visible “V6” badge on the tailgate area.
No year/production details are shown in the provided photos.
Photos show off-road style tires and a Tacoma body, but do not clearly confirm 4x4/transfer case or TRD-specific drivetrain badges.
No interior/ignition or keyless/push-start button is shown.
No roof/inside view is shown to confirm a moonroof.
No customs/duty documents or clearance proof is shown.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show repair history, panel gaps, underbody, or evidence of prior opening.
No mechanical start-up, driving, or diagnostic screenshots are shown.

risks.risk: Year/trim may not be 2024 or may not be TRD; wrong spec affects value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the dashboard VIN/vehicle info screen or the registration/inspection document showing year and trim, plus a photo of TRD/4x4-specific badges (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as an unspecified Tacoma with V6 badge only (no confirmed 2024/TRD/4x4), and treat as standard used import.

risks.risk: Drivetrain (4x4 vs 4x2) not confirmed; could be lower-spec.
risks.proof: Photo of the 4WD selector/transfer case lever (or dashboard 4WD indicator) and a short video showing engagement (with the vehicle stationary).
Cold-start video (engine start), short drive video, and a scan/OBD screenshot showing no active faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing mechanical checks/repairs (worst-case running condition not proven).

risks.risk: Accident/repaint/repairs not proven; photos don’t show body history.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of panel gaps, paint thickness readings (if available), underbody photos, and a body/accident report if the seller has it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case with unknown repair history (assume possible repaint/repairs until proven).

risks.risk: Import duty/clearance status not proven; could be problematic for registration.
risks.proof: Photos of customs/duty documents and the vehicle’s registration/clearance papers (showing VIN).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case with clearance not proven (assume buyer may face delays/costs).

risks.risk: Interior features (push-to-start, moonroof) and AC/electronics not confirmed.
risks.proof: Interior photos showing push-start button/ignition and roof controls, plus a video of AC blowing cold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case with features not guaranteed (assume missing/failed features).

risks.risk: Tyres and wear level unknown; could be near-worn or mismatched.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyre tread depth on all tyres and sidewall brand/model; include a photo of the spare if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case tyres may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: VIN/document authenticity risk (possible mismatch or incomplete paperwork).
risks.proof: Photo of VIN plate and VIN on documents, clearly matching; include registration number and chassis/VIN close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case paperwork authenticity not confirmed.

proof_requests: Provide VIN/chassis number close-up and matching photos from registration/clearance documents (showing year and trim).
Provide proof of duty/verified clearance (customs/duty documents) and current Abuja registration status.
Provide cold-start video and a short drive video (gear shifts smoothness, no warning lights).
Provide OBD/scan report screenshot (no active fault codes).
Provide interior photos showing push-to-start and moonroof controls/roof opening (if equipped).
Provide AC test video (cold air) and photos of dashboard/infotainment working.
Provide tyre tread depth close-ups for all tyres (and spare if available).
Provide underbody and close-up body panel alignment/paint condition photos to assess repairs.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Toyota Tacoma with a visible V6 badge, but key value drivers (year/trim, 4x4 confirmation, mechanical condition, clearance/duty, and interior features) are not verifiable from the photos. Without those proofs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
